title: Local authorization JWS claims v1
description: Single-use capability for exactly one signHash (SPEC §§8.5, 27.2; ADR-0013). Semantic rules not expressible in JSON Schema, mandatory for host and Hub: nbf <= now < exp with bounded clock skew; exp - iat <= configured maximum (default TTL 120 s); iss/instance_id/kid must belong to a locally trusted, non-revoked instance; origin must equal the real sender origin reported by the extension; every bound field must equal the signHash payload; consent fields must equal the top-level claims (instance, document hash, certificate); consent_manifest_sha256 must match the JCS hash of 'consent'; signed_attributes_digest_b64 is the digest of the CMS signed attributes and is never the document hash. Mandatory host order: (1) framing/size; (2) header and payload parsed with duplicate-member rejection; (3) header schema, ES256 only, 64-byte R||S; (4) kid resolved only in the local trusted store and signature verified; (5) claims schema and semantic checks above; (6) recompute consent_manifest_sha256 with an RFC 8785 implementation that passes fixtures/v1/crypto/jcs.vectors.json — BEFORE displaying consent; (7) display exactly 'consent' (the signed data), never page or extension text; (8) consume online at the Hub — a failed or ambiguous consumption (AUTHORIZATION_CONSUME_FAILED) aborts without any key access; (9) re-read the certificate, compare its fingerprint, then SignHash once. Consumption at the Hub is atomic and never idempotent.

iss.description: Hub issuer: the instance's exact HTTPS origin (see GET /api/v1/instance).

origin.description: Web origin allowed to request this operation through the extension.

document_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original, frozen PDF version (audit binding). Not signed by the key.

signed_attributes_digest_b64.description: SHA-256 of the DER-encoded CMS signed attributes produced by the Engine preparation. Exact input of SignHash.
